title: Where to Approximate in Neurosymbolic Inference?
abstract: arXiv:2611.13862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilistic neurosymbolic methods rely on weighted model counting (WMC) to combine neural predictors with symbolic constraints. Exact WMC is #P-hard and typically scales poorly, so many methods resort to approximations. By unifying existing approaches under a three-step bottom-up approximate compilation pipeline, we study where approximation budget is best allocated. Inspired by tensor networks, we instantiate two steps with tensor train decompositions and derive new pipelines that exactly multiply approximated factors and recompress their products via SVD- or interpolation-based schemes. Across six tasks in Sudoku, arithmetic reasoning, and scene understanding, and across increasing problem sizes, our pipelines produce WMC estimates orders-of-magnitude more accurate than prior methods. translated_title: 神经符号推理中应该在哪里进行近似？
translated_abstract: 概率神经符号方法依赖加权模型计数（WMC）来将神经预测器与符号约束相结合。精确的WMC是#P难问题且通常扩展性较差，因此许多方法转而采用近似手段。通过将现有方法统一在一个三步自底向上的近似编译管线框架下，我们研究了近似预算应如何最优分配。受张量网络的启发，我们使用张量列车分解来实例化其中的两个步骤，并推导出新的管线，这些管线能够精确地相乘近似后的因子，并通过基于SVD或插值的方案对其乘积进行再压缩。在数独、算术推理和场景理解的六个任务上，以及不断增大的问题规模下，我们的管线所产生的WMC估计比先前方法准确若干个数量级。这进而带来了更强的下游学习性能，尤其是在推理依赖于符号因子之间紧密交互的任务上，而这类任务中更粗糙的近似方法会……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文将现有近似WMC方法统一为三步自底向上编译管线框架，利用张量列车分解与基于SVD/插值的再压缩技术研究近似预算的最优分配位置，在数独、算术推理和场景理解等任务上实现了比先前方法准确数量级提升的WMC估计。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies existing approximate WMC approaches under a three-step bottom-up compilation pipeline, leveraging tensor train decompositions with SVD/interpolation-based recompression to study where approximation budget is best allocated, achieving WMC estimates orders-of-magnitude more accurate than prior methods across tasks like Sudoku, arithmetic reasoning, and scene understanding.
